name: Arcane Focus (Staff)
summary: Spellcasting Focus for Sorcerers, Warlocks and Wizards; also a Quarterstaff.
text: An Arcane Focus bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. Sorcerers, Warlocks and Wizards can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. It also counts as a Quarterstaff (1d6 Bludgeoning, Versatile 1d8, mastery Topple).
